root_cause.message: Canonical parking next-departure time differs from the destination activity.
root_cause.detail: HongKongCarParkingPersonSchedule incorrectly required canonical next_departure_time_s for the same physical vehicle to equal the current destination activity end time. Production has no cross-person vehicle use, but intervening non-Car trips can make the next Car departure later than that activity end.

local_repair.behavior: Keep exact arriving leg and destination identity checks; do not equate the next physical-vehicle departure with the arriving person's activity end time.

next_required_decision: Authorize or decline one new immutable release/run for the tested parking semantic repair.
